fields.label: Jira base URL
fields.help_text: The Jira REST API base URL. Only change for non-Skyway instances.

fields.label: Jira Personal Access Token
fields.help_text: Create/rotate at Skyway Service Desk. Never share this value.

fields.label: Client certificate (.p12)
fields.help_text: Optional. Only set if you use certificate-based auth.

fields.label: Certificate password
fields.help_text: Password for the .p12 file, if set.

fields.label: Local server port
fields.help_text: Port the MCP server listens on. Change only if 8000 is in use.
